test_title: PYST 13: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 9 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All sparrows are peacocks.

Some peacocks are birds.

**Conclusions:**

I. All birds are sparrow.

II. Some sparrows are not birds.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Statements:

All sparrows are peacocks.

Some peacocks are birds.

__Venn diagram:__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d7318a2f64055396852d506bfc9354609ee5acc27f5847582812171c752ef2b.png] 

Conclusions:

**I. All birds are sparrows: This does not follow **→ As because all sparrows are peacocks and only some peacocks are birds, there is no direct connection between birds and sparrows, so it is not possible that all birds are sparrows. {It is a doubtful positive statement}

**II. Some sparrows are not birds: This also does not follow **→ As because all sparrows are peacocks and only some peacocks are birds, so some sparrows can be birds. {It is a doubtful negative statement}

Hence, “**Neither conclusion I nor II follows**”. As none of the statements are appropriate.
